subject.title: feat(google): expose Flash Lite image cost estimate

question: Should Flash Lite image cost metadata use OpenClaw's canonical usage/model-pricing path, or establish a provider-local hardcoded image-output estimate contract?
rationale: Both approaches can produce the current $0.0336 value, but they have different API semantics, pricing-update ownership, and drift behavior that cannot safely be selected from the patch alone.

options.title: Use canonical usage pricing
options.body: Parse the real Google usage metadata and calculate the receipt through the shared pricing mechanism so pricing ownership remains centralized.

options.title: Approve provider-local estimate
options.body: Keep a deterministic Google-plugin estimate, but define it as image-output-only, cover implicit 1K requests, and document how price changes are maintained.

recommendation.title: Use canonical usage pricing
recommendation.body: Parse the real Google usage metadata and calculate the receipt through the shared pricing mechanism so pricing ownership remains centralized.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged image-generation runtime work is the strongest available history signal for choosing the cost-metadata contract.
